messages:
maya (PM): Proposal: formal pilot playbook for Optimize Toolkit focusing on batching+cache advisor, quantization recommendations, and eval-triggered alerts. Goal: non-invasive pilot with clear gates.
ci-bot: Doc created: /docs/optimize/pilot-playbook-draft by maya (PM) :page_facing_up:
derek (Eng): +1. For batching advisor we need API v1: POST /optimize/analyze -> suggested_batch, cache_positions, est_savings. Perf gate: p95 latency increase <=7% and cost decrease >=12% on pilot workload.
anika (SRE): Telemetry needed: batch_size_hist, cache_hit_rate, kv_evictions, end_to_end_p99, error_rate. Canary: 3% traffic 24h -> 15% 72h -> 50% 1w. Auto-rollback if p99 up >20% for 15m or error_rate >0.5%.
samir (CS): Pilot asks from customers: private-only profiling for AcmeHealth, savings preview for LexiDocs, minimal opt-in for SummitChat. Need one-page savings summary and FAQ.
lee (Ops): For Private, add local-only profiling mode and audit events for applied optimizations. Must surface KMS usage in docs.
derek (Eng): Quant recs plan: offline scorer + UI suggestion + runtime toggle `quant_profile=balanced|safe|aggressive`. Provide `rio estimate` CLI to simulate perf before apply. Add fallback variant annotated at runtime.
maya (PM): Draft acceptance gates: Wedge A: 3 pilots onboarded, median savings >=10%, no P0 regressions, SDK sample. Wedge B: safe default profile + validated rollback in canary + Console UI. Wedge C: 5 eval rule templates + oncall playbook + mitigation suggestions.
anika (SRE): Require smoke harness with short/long mixes and failure injection. Pilot telemetry retention 60d.
samir (CS): I'll start outreach; please share `rio estimate` MVP and one-pager template.
derek (Eng): Will land `rio estimate` MVP (JSON + simple HTML) this sprint.
maya (PM): Timeline proposal: A = 5w (incl buffer), B = 6w after A, C = 4w parallel soft work. Decision checkpoint next Tue EOD. Tagging for signoff. Thanks!
